files.author: Bilig
modifications: no free model with separate, named structures was found: NIH 3D's "Animal Cell" is CC BY-NC-SA (non-commercial, excluded), other cell models are paid marketplace models (CGTrader, 3DCadBrowser, Free3D royalty-free) or physical teaching models; so the model is authored by the pipeline script
three.js geometry extending the procedural animal cell of the approved Bilig Workbench prototype (bilig_ft plugin-gltf cells.ts)

named nodes for the topic's masks: Membrane (wavy, subtly bumpy), Cytoplasm, Nucleus (cut-away octant: double envelope rim, pores, chromatin; + Nucleolus), Mito_1…4 (bean-shaped, cut open lengthwise: double-membrane rim, cristae shelves from the inner wall), Ribo_1 (two-lobed granules on the rough ER), Ribo_2 (free), Golgi (curved cisternae with swollen rims, budding and free vesicles)
decorative, unnamed: rough ER (folded stacked sheets around the nucleus), smooth ER tubules, lysosomes, a centriole pair (9 microtubule triplets each)

cut-away organelles open towards the topic's default camera; organelles on the topic's concept anchors (Golgi and the rough ER moved slightly so they are not hidden behind the nucleus; anchors updated)

look: organic shapes from seeded 3D gradient noise + fbm (deterministic, mulberry32), per-vertex colour (COLOR_0) in the concept hue (hsl(h, 62%, 62%)) with noise tone variation and baked cavity / depth darkening; a small procedural tileable normal map (bumps) on organelles and membranes; organelles opaque, only the cell's shells translucent
gltf-transform: dedup, prune, weld, EXT_meshopt_compression + quantisation; KHR_materials_clearcoat, KHR_texture_transform

nodes: (4 decorative parts (rough ER, smooth ER, lysosomes, centrioles), renamed <root>_Mesh by quantisation; bound to no concept)
